title: China investigates politburo star in Xi Jinping’s latest purge
summary_full: Chen Jining, regarded as a contender for higher office, becomes the fourth member of China’s elite politburo to be investigated since 2025China has launched an investigation into Shanghai’s Communist party chief Chen Jining, a member of the country’s elite politburo, the state-run Xinhua news agency unexpectedly announced on Tuesday, marking the fourth member of the top leadership ⁠body to be probed since ⁠2025.China’s anti-graft watchdog is investigating ​Chen for “suspected severe violations of discipline and laws”, Xinhua said, using a common euphemism for corruption.
